statement: Alibaba's T-Head and Cambricon are testing CXMT's HBM3E with plans to put it into commercial processors as early as next year.
why: If Chinese accelerator designers can source domestic HBM, one of the last hard dependencies on Western-controlled supply weakens, and so does the pull for imported merchant GPUs.

impact.mechanism: A domestic memory path for Chinese accelerators substitutes local silicon for export-controlled merchant GPUs, trimming addressable China demand for the incumbent vendors.

evidence.excerpt: Domestic chip designers including Alibaba Group's T-Head unit and Cambricon Technologies are actively testing CXMT's HBM3E silicon, with plans to integrate the memory into commercial processors as early as next year.

confidence.basis: Single secondary outlet; qualification stage only, with commercial integration stated as a plan rather than a shipment.
